purpose: High-value source-backed pharmacology and medication-safety mechanisms for evaluation, retrieval attribution and case generation. This is not a comprehensive formulary and is not a patient-specific prescribing engine.
principles: Mechanistic relation does not automatically imply a clinical management recommendation.
Patient-specific dose/avoid/monitor actions require a current product label or applicable guideline.
FDA DDI tables are example/reference lists, not exhaustive drug-interaction databases.
PGx PK associations must not be silently upgraded to efficacy/toxicity or management claims.
Each module stores evidence scope and intended evaluation use.

modules.title: Renal transporter reasoning around metformin
